test_cases.name: test_retrieve_empty_collection_returns_empty_list
test_cases.description: Verify that retrieve() returns an empty list when the ChromaDB collection count is zero.
test_cases.code:
import pytest
from unittest.mock import MagicMock, patch
import src.rag as rag

def test_retrieve_empty_collection_returns_empty_list():
    mock_collection = MagicMock()
    mock_collection.count.return_value = 0
    mock_client = MagicMock()
    mock_client.get_or_create_collection.return_value = mock_collection

    with patch("src.rag.chromadb.PersistentClient", return_value=mock_client), \
         patch("src.rag.llm_client.embed", return_value=[0.0] * 768):
        results = rag.retrieve("search query")

    assert results == []
    assert isinstance(results, list)
